evidence_class: offline measurement of defined scenarios; no model inference; not an exhaustive bound
tokenizer: meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct tokenizer.json at revision 0cb88a4f764b7a12671c53f0838cd831a0843b95 (local gated asset, not committed)

selection.method: token counts from the supplied tokenizer; no character-length proxy

heavy_scenario.definition: 5 rounds of the largest inventory observation in the world, then reflection

assumptions.scenario: Only the scenarios above were measured. The heavy scenario repeats the largest observation the world can return in every round; it is the largest scenario that was constructed, not a proof that no episode is larger.

call_size.statement: Earlier sampled calls are replayed in later prompts at the size the model wrote them. The scenarios assume calls about as large as their schema requires. A call may be up to 1023 tokens, so the headroom above can be used up by long sampled arguments.

answer_size.statement: The merged reading allows this many tokens for the last generation. A sampled answer may be up to 1024 tokens.

assumptions.fragmentation: Whether turns merge depends on whether sampled tokens equal the template re-rendering; in Phase 3 every call was its own fragment. Both readings are checked.

budget.truncation_policy: never hidden: the adapter rejects a collection whose fragment tokens differ from sampled tokens
